text: EpsEvaluate[expr] applies total antisymmetry and linearity (w.r.t. momenta) to all Levi-Civita tensors (Eps) in expr.
Contract[LC[\[Mu], \[Nu], \[Rho], \[Sigma]] FV[p + q, \[Sigma]]] // MomentumCombine ex = EpsEvaluate[%]
ex // StandardForm (*Eps[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]], LorentzIndex[\[Nu]], LorentzIndex[\[Rho]], Momentum[p]] + Eps[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]], LorentzIndex[\[Nu]], LorentzIndex[\[Rho]], Momentum[q]]*)
